message: fix(crafting): require a clear workstation approach on client and server
purpose: Preserve the completed equipment and crafting candidate. Prevent crafting through solid furniture or walls. Add isolated server tests for NPC and owned stations, unchanged state on rejection, and working clear approaches. Do not change recipes, equipment balance, identity, saved data or existing test thresholds.

replacements.new: Snapshot.Nodes.Any(x => x.Zone == Snapshot.Self.Zone && x.Owner == Snapshot.Self.Id && x.Template == "structure_" + station && x.Position.Distance(Snapshot.Self.Position) <= 3 && WorldMap.LineOfSight(Data.Zone(Snapshot.Self.Zone), Snapshot.Self.Position, x.Position))
